verdicts.reason: A actually re-lays out the design for the tall format: a large two-line headline sits above a big product can, and the CTA is full-width and strong. But the missing-image sticker has been shrunk to a tiny box beside the legal line at the bottom, so that element is trivialised. The legal text is microscopic and left-aligned against a centred layout, and the gap between the headline and the can is loose. B is just the original shrunk onto the tall canvas: the can is small, the headline and CTA are reduced, and there are large dead bands above and below the product. The sticker floats at the top right, the legal text is barely legible, and nothing uses the extra height.
